text:
Ivy (CS): Quick capture from Today's Helio onboarding - main asks: 1) per-route spend caps so they can run nightly bulk embeddings without surprise bills, 2) clearer retry + error traces in Console for their SREs, 3) embeddings recall drops on long OCR'd manuals (~10k chars), 4) request for a short self-serve embedding checklist. They mentioned renewal conversation in 6 weeks and want visible movement.

Marco - PM: good notes. Can we get a reproducible sample for the embedding issue and a count of similar tickets? If it's widespread, we should prioritize the route-cap pilot.

Ivy (CS): Uploaded an anonymized sample to CS-8019 and pasted the minimal payload they shared: `{"file":"helio_manual_07.pdf","chars":10240}`. They said similarity rankings degrade after ~7k tokens.

Sam (Support): I see 5 related tickets in last 2 months tagged "embedding-low-recall". I'll attach anonymized samples to CS-8019 and tag severity.

Eli (Eng): initial hunch: chunking strategy + noisy OCR. If Ivy confirms samples are attached I can run a repro job (3 days). Interim advice might be 1k-2k token chunks with ~15% overlap and simple header/footer stripping.

Dana (Docs): I can draft a one-page checklist with chunking examples, overlap guidance, and quick OCR cleanup tips. Low lift.

Ivy (CS): csbot logged: "customer_signal: Helio - feature_ask/CS-8019" link: https://redwood.atlassian/CS-8019

csbot: New customer signal recorded: CS-8019 (Helio). Priority: candidate.

Marco - PM: proposed priority order: 1) per-route spend caps (pilot; revenue impact), 2) retry/error traces in Console (observability), 3) embeddings repro + guidance (engineering spike), 4) publish checklist (docs). Agree?

Sam (Support): agree. I'll mark Helio as revenue-risk for now and surface the repeat-offender count in the groom.

Eli (Eng): I'll own the repro spike. If reproducible with the sample, estimate 3 days for experiments + writeup. If it's model encoding behavior, timeline grows. I'll post updates in CS-8019.

Dana (Docs): I'll have a draft checklist by EOD Friday with SDK snippets and Console examples.

Ivy (CS): I'll send a short customer note: "Thanks — opening a pilot to add route-level caps and running a quick engineering spike to investigate embeddings recall. We'll share a short how-to guide this week and follow up with timelines after the spike. — Ivy"

Marco - PM: action items: Eli -> reproduce (owner). Dana -> docs. Sam -> attach tickets + counts. Ivy -> customer comms + pilot coordination. Scheduling a 20-min groom tomorrow to scope route-cap UI and billing metrics.

Ivy (CS): closing loop — link CS-8019 in the calendar invite. If anyone thinks we should deprioritize the checklist, say so now.

Marco - PM: keep both moving; checklist protects customers while we spike. :rocket:
